comment: This is easily the most regal Cambodian oud creation I have smelled in Pakistan. It is dark, opulent, and not screechy at all. Applied at 7 PM for a wedding, and I could still smell it on my sherwani the next morning. 10/10 masterwork.
The bourbon vanilla and ambergris base note gives it an unbelievable smooth creaminess. Everyone at office asked what I was wearing. Truly high-concentration Extrait.
A dark, moody May Rose far removed from ordinary sugary florals. The pink pepper opening is crisp, and the patchouli drydown feels like velvet. My absolute signature for evenings.
Packaging with wax seal and luxury box felt like receiving a gift from Paris. The trial tester policy made it completely risk-free.
Most citrus perfumes vanish after 3 hours—this one stays on for over 12 hours easily! The Italian neroli and Haitian vetiver give it immense depth. Perfect for daytime meetings.
Rich golden benzoin, roasted tonka bean, and labdanum. It wraps around you like a cashmere coat. One of the warmest gourmands in my 40+ perfume collection.
The best PKR 3,500 I have ever spent on perfumes. Getting 6 x 5ml glass atomizers lets you test all scents for weeks. Plus the coupon code inside gives you the money back on your full bottle!
